Miguel / Procurement team — thanks for the clear RFP. High level options below (we'll follow with a one-page matrix):

1) Hosted API (no platform fee) — pay per-token/embedding; best for quick time-to-value. Good if you want zero ops.

2) VPC / On-prem (recommended for regulated workloads) — pricing components:
   - Platform fee (annual): covers control plane, management, and feature access. Typical list: $90k/year for baseline (can be amortized).
   - Node licensing (per GPU node/hour or metered node seat). Example: $X per node/month (we'll show concrete bands).
   - Support retainer: Bronze (business hours), Silver (extended), Gold (24/7 + named SREs). Retainer examples: Bronze $5k/mo, Silver $12k/mo, Gold $30k/mo.
   - Optional on-call blocks and training days (prepaid).

3) Hybrid (Dedicated pools + VPC control plane) — blended pricing, platform fee adjusted downward if commit > 24 months.

Platform fee amortization: for term-based deals we commonly amortize the platform fee across the committed period (12/24/36 months) to reduce upfront burden. For example, a $90k platform fee amortized over 12 months -> $7.5k/mo spread. If CadenaTech wants a pilot, we can apply a timebound credit that phases into the full platform fee if you convert to a longer commit within 6 months.

Attached is a short pricing snapshot (VPC_pricing_snapshot.xlsx). Can we schedule a 30-minute call this week to run through node bands and their performance profiles? Thursday or Friday morning PST works on our side.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Markus — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifying items before we book time:

If you can send a one-pager that includes the amortized monthly platform fee for 12/18/24 months, a 50-node TCO example, and the Silver retainer SLA bullets + unit on-call price, we'll get this to our finance.

Miguel — appreciate the specificity. Below is the one-pager summary you requested (quick numbers so procurement can move):

- Platform fee (list): $90,000 / year
  - Amortized monthly: 12-mo -> $7,500/mo; 18-mo -> $5,000/mo; 24-mo -> $3,750/mo
  - Negotiation: we can offer a timebound onboarding credit up to 10% of first-year platform fee for an 18+ month committed term (applied as a lump-sum credit on invoice 1).

- 50-node example (approximate, assumes mixed CPU/GPU profile):
  - Node licensing + infra consumption: $220,000 over 12 months (total)
  - Add platform fee amortized 12-mo: + $90,000 -> TCO = $310,000 (12-mo)
  - 24-month model (assumes 10% discount on node licensing for 24-mo commit + amortized platform fee): ~ $370,000 total across 24 months (~$15.4k/mo average)

- Support retainer (what each tier buys):
  - Silver: 8x5 business-hours SLA, 2-hour P1 response, 4-hour P2 response, prioritized fixes during business hours. Suggested retainer: $12,000/mo.
  - Gold: 24x7 coverage, 1-hour P1 response, named SRE on-call, quarterly architecture reviews. Suggested retainer: $30,000/mo.
  - On-call block: 8-hour certified SRE block = $2,500 (one-time charge per block), usable within 90 days; can be purchased incrementally instead of upgrading tier.

Recommended packaging approach for CadenaTech:
- Pilot (6 mo): reduced platform fee (apply 50% onboarding credit up front), Silver retainer month-to-month, convert to 12/24 mo with onboarding credit reversed into first invoice if converted.
- Production (12 mo): amortize platform fee over 12 months, standard Silver retainer, 10% node licensing discount for commit > $300k/year.
- Strategic (24 mo+): deeper node licensing discount (15%), onboarding credit (10%), platform fee discount negotiable.

Next steps: I can join a 30-minute call with finance and procurement to walk the 50-node TCO line-by-line. If you can share preferred times, we'll lock a meeting.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
